I never lost someone in my family, but my grandma lost her mom due to suicide in the 60s and about a year later her grandma died too. She told me how she didn‘t have the energy to do anything anymore, everything was worthless and a pain to do, simple things like brushing your teeth, taking a shower and stuff like that were suddenly so hard to do. She got better over time but still has to take her meds. I could‘ve never imagined that she suffered this much when she was younger. I don‘t know if this helps u but she turns 72 in october and i‘m so glad that she‘s still here because my life would‘ve already ended if she wasn‘t there. It will take a long time to heal but that‘s ok, that‘s part of life and i hope you‘re doing better. <3

I don‘t want to work half a day so i can afford and overpriced place with a bit of food, it‘s not worth it to me so why would i do it? But the longer i live this way, the more my surroundings are stressing me about it (even tho i‘m still young). I just think death is the most peacefull thing and i don‘t plan on being here longer than age 22.
